metadata.name: German Collector Trial Pre-Impact Sediment Core Analysis
metadata.description: This dataset contains sediment core analysis from the German collector trial pre-impact, including measurements of various elements (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their relative errors at different depths. The data is geolocated at a single point in the Pacific Ocean with coordinates 11.93056667 N, -117.0224333 W and an elevation of -4087.8 meters. All records were taken on March 10, 2019.
